headline: In 182 real incidents the first replacement bus ran a median 87 min after the incident started (0% within 15 min, 25% within 1 h), and timetabled EV buses make 32 km/h by road; these learned speeds cut the hop-time error on held-out routes from 2.70 to 2.19 min vs the old flat 50 km/h.

notes: Interrupted = some version of the incident has summary 'Interrupted service' / 'Unterbruch' (480 of 550).

The bus sentence (de 'Ersatzbus', fr 'bus de remplacement', it 'autobus sostitutiv', en 'replacement bus' in summary or description) is in the FIRST version of 148/480 interrupted incidents (31%); 347/480 (72%) carry it in SOME version (median 52.8 min after the start). The 347/480 = 72% of the earlier hand count is the any-version count.

Message classes use title + text; with titles only (the earlier hand count) search n=33 (median 44.2 min), running n=35 (median 90.0 min). Title + text gives more incidents and similar quartiles; 'running' ignores sentences in the future tense ('les bus circuleront', 'der erste Bus soll').

Dropped as < 0 or > 24 h: {'firstSearch': 1, 'firstConfirmed': 0, 'firstShortage': 0, 'firstRunning': 2}. Search -> running: 3 incidents whose first search message came at or after the first running bus (looking for more buses) are excluded.
Shortage = 'only one bus', 'no replacement buses (yet / available)', 'not enough buses', 'Engpässe bei Ersatzbussen' etc.: 11 incidents (the earlier hand count found 5 on titles only).
Out-of-time check: quantiles fitted on the earliest 60% of incidents by start date (109), coverage on the later 73.
The liveticker shows what the control centre published, not when buses physically left; publication lags reality.

Speed: EV routes = route_short_name EV/EVn or route_desc EV (341 routes; types {'700': 339, '109': 1, '106': 1}); routes whose stops are mostly rail platforms are dropped (['91-EV-C-j26-1', '92-6-Y-j26-1', '92-A00-J-j26-1', '92-A00-S-j26-1', '92-A01-B-j26-1', '92-A01-D-j26-1', '92-A07-Q-j26-1', '92-R-Y-j26-1', '92-U-Y-j26-1']). Hops dropped: {'zeroMinutes': 67, 'straightUnder300m': 129, 'speedOutside5to100': 66}. Scheduled times are rounded to whole minutes, so short hops are noisy.
Speeds come from the planned (timetabled) EV trips of the 2026 timetable (construction closures), not from ad-hoc emergency buses, which have no timetable.

stationStops: 1592 of 1736 Swiss rail stations (DIDOK 85xxxxx parents served by route types 2/100-117) mapped ({'ev': 1306, 'transfer': 1481, 'bus': 286, 'none': 144, 'estimate': 111, 'stations': 1736}); walkMin from transfers.txt footpaths when present, else ceil(walkM / 80 m/min).
